limits: These are the same existing repeated80.04s recordings on one M4 Pro with ordinary background activity, not new captures, physical microphone, untouched held-out data or an uncontended performance comparison.

The CLI observer starts its clock before feeding320sample blocks at20ms cadence and polls after each push, before scheduled sleep. A block can lead its nominal real-time endpoint by20ms; signed ages are retained.

A processed-audio frontier is not an acoustic word/speaker onset, first visible label, finality watermark or stable prefix. Intermediate turn contents and actual GUI/IPC/render timestamps were not retained.

This trace cannot separate capture/file-writing, queueing, native lookahead/compute, snapshot policy or polling costs. Exact actual finalization delay is also unobserved. No actual end-to-end label-latency gate closes.

The previous-observed-frontier statistic describes this saved polling trace only; it is not a GUI staleness bound. Profiles were run at different times/builds, so their descriptive values do not establish a pooling performance effect.
All three traces, including every retained revision, must be reported. No parameter/cadence/reference/quality gate changes or new model/app/native execution are performed.
